noise_contract.held: additive Gaussian, same realization for candidate and comparators
noise_contract.training: mean-one lognormal step labels; three trials/cell; marginal CV; iid or shared-trial normal correlation0.8
noise_contract.endpoints: Timing-label noise does not alter true executed work, features or causal arrival schedule.
noise_contract.limitations: Truth is inside M2; no out-of-family misspecification, config error, noisy features or non-Gaussian held tails. Rates are scenario-conditional; not actual GPU power.

dependence_note: Many held draws share one training fit. Report ranges across training seeds; do not claim they are all independent full experiments.
